type Cache[K comparable, V any] struct // Cache is a bounded, expiring in-memory cache shared by an organisation's streams.
  func (*Cache[K, V]).Get(ctx context.Context, key K, load func(context.Context) (V, error)) (V, error) // Get returns the value for key, loading it with load on a miss or after the entry expired.
  func (*Cache[K, V]).Len() int // Len reports how many entries the cache holds, including expired entries, so tests of its users can observe retention after shutdown.
  func (*Cache[K, V]).Waiting(key K) int // Waiting reports how many callers have joined the load in flight for key (0 if none), so tests can synchronise on it instead of sleeping.
type CachedEvents struct // CachedEvents is an EventReader that shares reads between an organisation's streams: streams at the same cursor share a full batch's read; for a short one, the read's joiners share one more private read.
  func (*CachedEvents).EventsAfter(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, after int64, limit int) ([]Event, error) // EventsAfter implements EventReader.
type Connection struct // Connection names who holds a stream: the organisation from the URL, and the account and session that authenticated the request.
  field Account github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID
  field Organization github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID
  field Session github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID
const DefaultBatchSize untyped int = 100 // DefaultBatchSize bounds how many events one read returns.
const DefaultCacheLoads untyped int = 16 // DefaultCacheLoads bounds concurrent loaders in each production cache.
const DefaultMaxStreams untyped int = 5000 // DefaultMaxStreams caps open streams per process, leaving headroom below the measured active-stream ceiling (docs/architecture/load-testing.md).
const DefaultRetention time.Duration = 604800000000000 // DefaultRetention keeps seven days of replay history.
var ErrAccountCancelled error // ErrAccountCancelled ends connections cancelled by CancelAccount.
var ErrCursorExpired error // ErrCursorExpired means the cursor is outside the valid replay range: below the replay boundary or above the committed event_seq.
var ErrSessionEnded error // ErrSessionEnded ends connections cancelled by CancelSession.
var ErrShutdown error // ErrShutdown ends every connection when the server shuts down.
var ErrTooManyConnections error // ErrTooManyConnections refuses a registration over either stream limit.
var ErrUnregistered error // ErrUnregistered ends a connection whose unregister function ran.
type Event struct // Event is a durable change ordered within an organisation: an envelope that realtime routes without knowing its kind (decision 26).

  field Payload []byte
  field Seq int64
  field Topics []github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID
type EventCleaner interface // EventCleaner deletes expired rows and raises replay boundaries in atomic batches.
  func (EventCleaner).ExpireEvents(context.Context, time.Time) error
type EventKind string // EventKind identifies a durable change.
type EventReader interface // EventReader reads an organisation's durable events with a sequence above after, in sequence order, at most limit of them.
  func (EventReader).EventsAfter(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, after int64, limit int) ([]Event, error)
func FormatPayloadID(id github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) string // FormatPayloadID returns id as canonical UUID text (8-4-4-4-12, lowercase), the form PostgreSQL's uuid type prints, so payloads keep one shape whichever writer stored them.
type Hub struct // Hub holds, per organisation, the highest committed event sequence it has been told about, and the registry of open connections.
  func (*Hub).ActiveOrganizations() []github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID // ActiveOrganizations returns the organisations with at least one registered connection, in no particular order.
  func (*Hub).CancelAccount(account github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) // CancelAccount ends the contexts of all the account's connections, for example when the account signs out everywhere.
  func (*Hub).CancelAll() // CancelAll ends the contexts of every registered connection and refuses every later registration with ErrShutdown, for a server shutting down: an open stream never goes idle, so the server would otherwise wait for it until its shutdown deadline, and a request already accepted could still register after this ran.
  func (*Hub).CancelSession(session github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) // CancelSession ends the contexts of the session's connections, for example when it signs out or is replaced.
  func (*Hub).Connections() int // Connections returns how many connections are registered, for the development-only metrics listener.
  func (*Hub).Latest(org github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) int64 // Latest returns the organisation's latest sequence the hub has been told about; 0 if none.
  func (*Hub).Raise(org github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, seq int64) // Raise records that the organisation's events up to seq are committed.
  func (*Hub).RaiseIfActive(org github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, seq int64) // RaiseIfActive is Raise for an organisation that still has a registered connection, checked under the same lock, so a value read while its last connection went away does not raise it.
  func (*Hub).Register(parent context.Context, c Connection, limit int) (ctx context.Context, unregister func(), err error) // Register adds a connection unless the process already holds maxStreams connections or its account holds limit connections, returning ErrTooManyConnections and nothing to unregister, or the hub is shutting down (ErrShutdown).
  func (*Hub).Wait(ctx context.Context, org github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, after int64) (int64, error) // Wait blocks until the organisation's latest sequence is greater than after and returns that sequence, at once if it already is.
  func (*Hub).Waiting(org github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) int // Waiting reports how many calls of Wait for the organisation are counted as blocked, so tests can synchronise on it instead of sleeping.
type Interest string // Interest identifies output a connection asks to receive, never permission.
const InterestMessages Interest = "messages" // InterestMessages requests posts and moves in the selected channel or topic.
const InterestSidebar Interest = "sidebar" // InterestSidebar declares sidebar output; no sidebar frames are delivered yet.

  field Name string

type Renderer interface // Renderer turns an event the subscription wants into what the stream sends; the stream does the subscription's filtering, so a render depends only on the event.
  func (Renderer).Render(ctx context.Context, event Event) (Outgoing, error)
type Retention struct // Retention expires replay history at start and on each tick; messages and unread state remain.
  field Events EventCleaner
  field Period time.Duration // Period defaults to DefaultRetention when nonpositive.
  func (Retention).Run(ctx context.Context, ticks <-chan time.Time) // Run cleans up immediately, retries failed cleanups on the next tick and stops with ctx.
type RetentionBoundary interface // RetentionBoundary locks an organisation for retention and raises its replay boundary, inside the cleaner's transaction; org owns both (decision 26).
  func (RetentionBoundary).LockForRetention(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) error

type Stream struct // Stream runs the per-connection delivery loop.
  field Authorizer Authorizer
  field BatchSize int // BatchSize bounds each read; zero means DefaultBatchSize.
  field Events EventReader
  field Heartbeat time.Duration // Heartbeat is how long the loop waits on the hub before it sends a heartbeat and waits again; zero sends none.
  field Hub *Hub
  field Renderer Renderer
  func (Stream).Run(ctx context.Context, sub Subscription, cursor int64, send Sender) (int64, error) // Run delivers the subscription's events with a sequence above cursor until ctx ends or delivery fails, and returns the last sequence it delivered or skipped, with the reason it stopped.
type Subscription struct // Subscription is one connection's explicit interests in an organisation, scoped to a channel or topic for messages, on behalf of an account.

  field Channel github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID
  field Interests []Interest // Interests is the set of requested output; empty means no message delivery.
  field Organization github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID
  field OrganizationSlug string
  field Topic *github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID // Topic, when set, narrows the channel to one topic (a topic view).
type Watermark struct // Watermark raises the hub to each active organisation's committed sequence.
  func (Watermark).Check(ctx context.Context) error // Check reads, in one query, the committed sequences of the organisations with registered connections and raises the hub to those still active; a value that is not ahead changes nothing.
  field Hub *Hub
  func (Watermark).Run(ctx context.Context, ticks <-chan time.Time) // Run calls Check on every tick until ctx ends.
  field Sequences SequenceReader
  field Timeout time.Duration // Timeout bounds each check; zero means watermarkCheckTimeout.
const WatermarkInterval time.Duration = 5000000000 // WatermarkInterval is how often Watermark checks the committed sequences.
